local function describe(label)
    local frame = StoreFrame
    local secureFrame = __secureenv and rawget(__secureenv, "StoreFrame")
    local secureStore = __secureenv and rawget(__secureenv, "C_StoreSecure")
    print("STORE_PUBLIC_STATE", label, frame:IsShown(), frame:IsVisible(), frame:IsForbidden(), frame:IsEventRegistered("STORE_PRODUCTS_UPDATED"))
    print("STORE_FRAME_IDENTITIES", label, frame == rawget(_G, "StoreFrame"), frame == secureFrame)
    print("STORE_NAMESPACE_IDENTITIES", label, C_StoreSecure == secureStore, secureStore and C_StoreSecure.GetProductList == secureStore.GetProductList)
    for _, script in ipairs({"OnShow", "OnEvent"}) do
        local fn = frame:GetScript(script)
        print("STORE_SCRIPT", label, script, type(fn))
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            local info = debug.getinfo(fn, "S")
            print("STORE_SCRIPT_SOURCE", label, script, info and info.source, info and info.linedefined)
        end
    end
    local info = debug.getinfo(C_StoreSecure.GetProductList, "S")
    print("STORE_LIST_SOURCE", label, info and info.source, info and info.linedefined)
    local shown, populated = 0, 0
    for _, card in ipairs(frame.ProductCards or {}) do
        if card:IsShown() then shown = shown + 1 end
        if card:GetID() > 0 then populated = populated + 1 end
    end
    print("STORE_CARD_COUNTS", label, shown, populated)
end
assert(StoreFrame, "original StoreFrame required")
describe("before")
StoreFrame:Show()
describe("shown")
C_StoreSecure.GetProductList()
describe("requested")
print("STORE_PUBLIC_IDENTITY_TRACE_COMPLETE")
